note: Sizes in CSS px at the reference widths. Board grid is always dir=ltr. Desktop frame = DS table frame (rail | felt | chat).

desktop.board: fluid (v1.3, like chess.com): min(felt height − 2 × playerBar − 2 × gap − 2 × feltPadding.block, felt width − 32); 688 at 1440×900, 880 at 1920×1080, 700 in a bot game without chat at 1440×900

coordinates.rank: inside left column, top-left of square
coordinates.file: inside bottom row, bottom-right of square

board.flash: illegal attempt: king square rgba(229,72,77,.82) with a dark red inner frame, two blinks of 200 ms
board.promotion: white column over the target file from the far edge: Q, N, R, B (rows = 1 square each), ✕ max(44 px, half a square); board dimmed rgba(0,0,0,.38)

piece.fill: 100% of square (art has its own margins)
piece.capturedChip: light chip #E9E4DA only behind BLACK captured pieces

clock.digits: Peyda 900, Persian digits, fixed-width box, no tabular-nums
